positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a senior software developer in BlackRock, I have Contributed to UI framework used as it’s enterprise CRM. Worked with a team to design and develop it’s Jquery frontend framework. Created an SPA web application built on a Java Spring MVC layer and an enterprise service layer consisting of Google protos, Spring and Hibernate.

Designed and implemented an enterprise server application based on EWS API to create tasks and activities from correspondence and meetings from company’s mail client. The server application was built via Java Multithreading framework and Spring with AOP and Spring JDBC.

Developed and maintained custom .NET Solution for Enterprise Customer Management Software. Solution was built in C# using .NET 3.5 framework along with SQL Server 2008 as the backed storage.

Dev lead on multiple functional projects and applications across CMT tools and technology. 

Mentored and Managed junior software developers responsible for contributing to the web platform.

positions.title: .NET Software Developer
positions.description: Worked on Expeditor's ECS project to help architect UI layer and develop custom reporting solution. ECS was developed using .NET Winforms UI,  WCF Service layer, SSRS and SQL Server backend

positions.title: Frontend Software Developer
positions.description: Worked as the main UI developer of Cisco’s Partner Practice Builder project. Project was based on ASP.NET, Silverlight front-end, WCF Service middle tier and SQL Server backend.

positions.title: Lead UI Software Developer
positions.description: Worked as UI lead on AHP Federal loan application based on SharePoint and ASP.NET Ajax technologies
